raw.title: Arazzo 1.0.1 Released!
raw.body:
The OAI is pleased to announce the official release of the Arazzo Specification 1.0.1!

## What's Changed
* Fix example documents for LoginAndRetrievePets workflow by @apalm in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/214
* Fix example issues by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/260
* Fix retryAfter description to match available `types` by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/230
* Fix type in WorkflowId description by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/301
* Improve clarity around `workflowId` in success and failure actions by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/301
* Use RFC 9110 instead of RFC 7230 for Header Field guidance by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/301
* Use RFC 9110 instead of RFC 7231 for payload (or request content) guidance by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/301
* sourceDescription typo and emphasis on MUST by @jeremyfiel in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/234
* fix typo in Step Object description by @bpedro in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/249
* Remove mentions of `message` from the expression syntax for 1.0.* by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/269
* Remove `body` from possible values of the `in` field within ParameterObject by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/284
* Fix typo in Step Object `operationPath` fixed field description by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/284

## JSON Schema
* Add JSON Schema for the Arazzo Specification by @jeremyfiel in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/230 

## Infrastructure Items
* respec build script: create minor-version symlinks by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/289
* schema-publish workflow by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/290
* Temporary fix for schema-publish.yaml: reduce list of reviewers by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/294
* spec build workflow: dynamically determine latest spec version by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/296
* Workflows with app-generated access token by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/302

## New Contributors
* @apalm made their first contribution in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/214
* @bpedro made their first contribution in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/249

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/compare/1.0.0...1.0.1
